name: NorthstarSupportChatbot
description: This flow manages customer interactions with the Northstar Support Chatbot, classifying inquiries and routing them for appropriate responses.

customer_message.description: The incoming message from the customer.

order_id.description: The order number if provided by the customer.

product_name.description: The product name being inquired about.

category.description: The category to which the customer query has been classified.

final_reply.description: The finalized reply message generated for the customer.

methods.name: classify_question
methods.description: Classifies the customer inquiry into a specific category.

methods.name: route_by_category
methods.description: Routes the inquiry to the appropriate branch based on its category.

methods.name: check_order_id_present
methods.description: Checks to see if an order ID was provided in the customer's inquiry.

methods.name: lookup_order_status
methods.description: Retrieves the order status based on the provided order ID.

methods.name: save_order_reply
methods.description: Saves the composed reply about the order status to the state.

methods.name: request_order_id
methods.description: Requests the customer to provide their order ID for further assistance.

methods.name: save_order_id_missing_reply
methods.description: Saves the reply that prompts the customer to provide their order ID.

methods.name: lookup_return_policy
methods.description: Retrieves the return policy for items specified in the customer's request.

methods.name: save_return_reply
methods.description: Saves the composed reply regarding the return policy to the state.

methods.name: check_stock_availability
methods.description: Checks stock availability for the product mentioned in the customer's inquiry.

methods.name: save_stock_reply
methods.description: Saves the reply regarding stock availability to the state.

methods.name: flag_for_human_review
methods.description: Flags inquiries that cannot be addressed by the chatbot for human review.

methods.name: save_escalation_reply
methods.description: Saves the reply indicating the escalation to human support.
